body.name: Global minimax criteria
body.construction:
\[
 R^{\star}=\inf_{\widetilde\theta}\sup_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}
 \mathbb E_x[(\widetilde\theta(Z)-\ell(x))^2].
\]
Here the infimum is over measurable real-valued statistics.  Moreover,
\[
 \operatorname{EL}^{\star}_{\alpha}
 =\inf_{C}\sup_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}
 \mathbb E_x[\operatorname{length}C(Z)],
\]
where the infimum is over measurable interval-valued maps \(C\) such that
\(C(Z)\) is an interval almost surely under every \(x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}\) and
\[
 \inf_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}
 \Pr_x\{\ell(x)\in C(Z)\}\ge1-\alpha.
\]
